beats.headline: Behind the counter
beats.text: For the record: the pub is dark and stinks of death when a voice behind the counter hisses at Crawler Donut to turn off her light. She is out there. She came in once already and ate the subject's husband right out of the doorway. The subject is a large bear in an apron with two small cubs clutched in her arms, and a Terrified debuff blinking over her head. Prudence. Level twenty-eight Ursine Barmaid. Yes, she says, that is Big Tina outside. She came back for her revenge, for what the clerics did.

beats.headline: The secret recital
beats.text: Her account. Dancing is forbidden, but a community of mothers taught the children ballet in secret and planned a small recital. The best dancer was eight years old, the daughter of the town's head cleric, and was to dance last. Her name was Tina. Her father found out and stormed the school with his clerics. Tina's mother slapped him in front of the congregation. He whipped her to the edge of death on the stage, pushed Tina aside, and she fell. The wand that was meant to shoot sparkles broke. Sinners get what they deserve, says her cub Randy. That's right, honey.

beats.headline: Her grandmother's faith
beats.text: Before the cleric could punish the others, the nine-tier attack came. Most died. Only females were transformed; a small handful survived unchanged, including the subject's grandmother, the most pious, whose faith saved her. Tina was the only child who turned, and her mind is gone. Her mother and several other mothers survive as dinosaurs, and her mother still tries to hold her back. Her name, the subject tells Crawler Carl, is Kiwi. Quest Update: The Recital.

beats.headline: Now you can
beats.text: Crawler Carl tells the subject to take her children through the door they came out of. She tried it before, she says, and it would not let her. You can now, he says, and gives her and her cubs access. Once Big Tina has moved down the street, Prudence and her two cubs are inside the guildhall, and Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut go out into the rain.

beats.headline: Dinosaur movies on the couch
beats.text: The subject sits on the couch with her cubs crawling all over her, acting like nothing happened. A Land Before Time sequel is on, which Crawler Carl finds a little fucked-up, since the cubs have just watched their dad get eaten by a dinosaur. They seem to like it. Little Todd complains to Mordecai about the accuracy of the dinosaurs.

beats.headline: Samantha in her lap
beats.text: Back in the saferoom, the subject sits on the couch with a cub on either side while a nineties horror movie with an animatronic tyrannosaurus plays. Samantha is in her lap, having her hair stroked by the bear. Crawler Carl does not ask. Bomo and the Sledge watch the screen with the rest of them.

beats.headline: Asleep through the bickering
beats.text: Her cubs spend the evening feuding with the changeling children. Randy tells Bonnie the gnome she is going to hell and that all heathens burn in the fires of judgement; When Skarn tells him not to be mean, Todd stands behind his brother. The subject, the mother of the two bears, is passed out on the couch, snoring.

beats.headline: Never part of the plan
beats.text: The mantises take the airship, and the Sledge has to jump. His report: he is okay, Bonnie is okay, the bear cubs are okay, Prudence is okay. Crawler Carl notes that they never agreed to save Prudence and the cubs; they were meant to stay in the saferoom until the collapse and simply disappear. He tells the Sledge to protect Bonnie and the bears if he can, but not to sacrifice himself for any of them.

beats.headline: Died protecting two babies
beats.text: Prudence, ursine barmaid, is dead. The notice comes from the Sledge, in his clipped way, while a mushroom crawler takes the stage in the ballroom: Prudence dead. Died protecting two babies. They're crying. Hugging Bonnie. Too many mantises. Still fighting. Crawler Carl's assessment at that moment is that the plan is done. The Sledge reports a while after that the cubs are safe, for now.

beats.headline: According to Prudence
beats.text: Tina finally dances. Two cretins hold up a ship's mainsail painted with waves, and she twirls across the stage, casting sparkles. According to Prudence, poor dead Prudence, the dance Tina was supposed to perform was called the Water Ballad, and it was about a mer-bear. The recital the subject described goes on, long after, without her.

beats.headline: The orphaned cubs
beats.text: Randy and Todd, the orphaned ursine cubs, come running out of a guild in metal skull caps, dragging training spears, with little Clint, a flesh golem now in a kindergartner's body. They want to fight. Miss Nadine has told them to stay away from Tina because she killed their dad, Clint reports, but Tina is different now and her mother says she has apologized. Randy says they have been practising. Todd means to bathe in apostate blood.
